recentItems.title: Disha Salian Case: CBI Registers FIR; Father’s Statement Names Rhea Chakraborty, Dino Morea
recentItems.description:
A major development has taken place in the Disha Salian death case, nearly six years after her death. The Central Bureau of Investigation, or CBI, has registered an FIR in connection with the death of Disha Salian, who was the former manager of late actor Sushant Singh Rajput. The FIR comes after the Bombay High Court directed the CBI to conduct a thorough investigation into the circumstances surrounding Salian’s death. Disha Salian was found dead on June 8, 2020, just days before Sushant Singh Rajput was found dead at his residence in Bandra, Mumbai. Watch the video.

recentItems.title: Bigg Boss 20 ‘Boring’ Contestant Row: Salman Khan’s REACTION Leaves Everyone Surprised
recentItems.description:
Bigg Boss 20 may be only a week old, but viewers have already started forming strong opinions about the new season. While the drama inside the house is slowly picking up, one complaint has repeatedly come from fans: the contestants aren't exciting enough. Several viewers have called the casting “boring”, mainly because the season does not have too many instantly recognisable faces. And now, during Weekend Ka Vaar, Salman Khan appeared to address the conversation in his own cheeky style. Watch the video.
